title: LunaToolRequest
description: Standard schema for invoking tools across LUNA AI runtime and agent planner.

tool.description: Identifier of the target tool to invoke

action.description: Specific action to perform within the tool

parameters.description: Key-value input parameters defined by the tool's input schema

user_id.description: ID of the user making the request

confirmation_token.description: Token proving user confirmed execution for high-risk tools
